newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was moderate in Kansas on Tuesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers steady to $1.00 higher; heifers steady.

Inquiry fairly good, demand fair. Sales confirmed on 12600 slaughter steers and 11600 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 56800 head confirmed, including 21200 head or about 37 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Slaughter steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1350 lbs 68.00, Select with end Choice 1125-1225 lbs 67.00; pen Select with end Choice 1100 lb Brahma cross 66.00.
Dressed Basis Few Select and Choice 2-3 1150 lbs 110.00.
Slaughter heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1175 lbs 68.00; few Select with end Choice 67.00-67.50; pen Select and Choice with small end heiferettes 67.00.
week to date: 56800 last week: 17800 last year: 32100
